AI Workspace local modifications, 2026-11-18
Upstream source: OpenAI Sign in with ChatGPT DevKit,
commit 0a36fefeb913055c8c7a1a29b63d82b96b2e841a.

Changed packages/local/src/types.ts to add optional reasoningEffort and
responseSchema fields, plus inline text/image message content.
Changed packages/local/src/responses.ts to validate reasoning effort, forward
the official reasoning.effort and strict text.format schema parameters, and
validate inline image data and stop on a refusal event instead of treating it as an empty JSON reply.
Generated packages/local/dist files reflect these two source modifications.

Authentication, registration, consent, encrypted credential storage, token
refresh, account switching, revocation and admission handling are unchanged.
